methodologyNotes: Covers standalone wall and travel USB-C chargers built on gallium-nitride (GaN) power electronics, sold at a published US price. Excludes silicon-only chargers, power banks/portable batteries, car chargers, wireless charging pads, and bare cables. Price is typical US MSRP in USD. maxOutputWatts is the manufacturer-rated total combined output across all ports, in watts. singlePortMaxWatts is the highest output deliverable from a single port, in watts. usbcPortCount and usbaPortCount are integer counts of USB-C and USB-A ports respectively. pdRevision is the highest USB Power Delivery revision supported, as an enum ("PD 3.1", "PD 3.0", or "PD 2.0"). ppsSupport is a boolean: true if any port supports USB-PD Programmable Power Supply (PPS). foldablePlug is a boolean: true if the AC prongs fold flat on the US plug. acInputRange is the rated AC input voltage window in volts, written low-high (e.g. "100-240"). weightGrams is the adapter weight in grams, prongs included and cables excluded. volumeCubicIn is the enclosure bounding-box volume in cubic inches, computed from the published length x width x height with prongs folded. warrantyYears is the manufacturer's stated warranty length in years.
